column1: # Datasets manifest — one row per study to fetch + process.
# The reconciler (reconcile.py --manifest) and driver (run_batch.sh) read this.
# Copy to config/manifest.tsv and edit for your studies.
#   accession    label used in reports and the retry ledger (e.g. GSE219015)
#   workdir      the study's pipeline workdir (matches its config's workdir:)
#   samples_tsv  the sheet prepare_runs.py wrote for it
#   configfile   the config passed to run_slurm.sh --configfile
# ONE GENOME PER STUDY: the pipeline refuses a sheet mixing genomes, so split
# a multi-species study into separate rows with separate sheets.
# A study spanning species becomes two rows, because prepare_runs.py writes one
# sheet per genome and each needs its own workdir and config.
